utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what’s the plan for the repair drive? Do you need me to bring anything or help with setup?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, if you can bring some packing tape and a marker, that’d help a lot. And if you’ve got a few minutes early, I could use an extra hand with setup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive—just let me know what you need. I’m happy to help out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great—thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout—people have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re heading over, you might still catch the volunteers before they pack up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I should check the timing first—if I’m going, I don’t want to miss them or show up when they’re already packing up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s smart—last I heard they were aiming to stay a bit longer, but it’s probably worth giving it a quick check before you head out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the repair drive is over by the community center lot. If you want, I can help keep track of where everything’s being dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Opal—that’d be a big help. I’ll head over to the community center lot and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, though I’ll need to keep it brief today. What’s the repair drive needing most?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s kind of you, Uli—just come by if you can, even a short hand helps. We’re mostly short on tools and a few extra hands to sort and fix things.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help organize the repair drive and keep everything moving. Leo, what do you need first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Oh, right — thanks for asking. I’m still nailing down the exact spot, but let’s aim for Saturday around 4; I’ll send you the meeting place as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Leo — Saturday at 4 works for me. Just send the meeting place when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what the repair drive needs first? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I think we should start by sorting the broken stuff by what’s fixable first, then we can check what parts or tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll sort the broken items by what looks fixable first, then we can check the parts and tools list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I’m trying to work around the school pickup schedule for the repair drive. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Faye, I was thinking we could start around 4:30, after school pickup. If that’s too tight, I’m happy to shift it a bit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 should work for me after pickup. Thanks for being flexible, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon—what do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it’s a neighborhood repair drive where folks can bring in broken small items and get help fixing them up. I can check the time and place if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—I'd really appreciate the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are you still handling the repair drive drop-off today?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still handling the drop-off today. Just tell me where and when to bring it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—do you know what they still need? I can probably help if it’s something small.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey—I'm not totally sure, but I think they still need a few basic tools and maybe some spare nails. I can check around and let you know!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks. Just let me know if you find out, and I can bring whatever’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring what they can. I’ll let people know it’s coming up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you spreading the word. That’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll make sure folks hear about it. I’ll keep reminding them to bring anything they can contribute.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is really picking up—I'll keep an ear out while I'm out running errands. Let me know if there's anything specific you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. If you hear of anyone with a spare drill or some extra extension cords, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll ask around for a spare drill or any extra extension cords while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help if you need a hand; just point me to where things are being dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — that’s really kind. I’ll point you to the drop-off spot once I hear where they want everything set up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — just let me know, and I’ll head over when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, but I can help if you remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, thanks for reminding me—what’s still left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a clear list and let you know what to bring by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli—I'll check my toolbox tonight and have it ready for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Mara, I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive already — it’s really coming together. If you want, I can pass along an invite to anyone you think should come.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Opal! I’m glad the repair drive is getting some attention—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Jules — can you tell me where the repair drive is being held and what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s being held at the neighborhood community center on Maple Street, and it starts at 10 a.m. tomorrow. I can send you the details if you want!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive sheet ready, and I’ll start matching folks with the biggest needs first. Let’s make sure everyone knows where to bring requests.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll post the pickup spot and keep a running list as requests come in. If you hear of anyone with urgent repairs, send them my way right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks were putting together a repair drive—what kind of help do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mostly tools, spare parts, and a few hands to help fix things. Do you know anyone who can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can spread the word, but I’m still hearing things second-hand myself. If you tell me what tools or parts are most needed, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — could you help sort the drop-off times and keep an eye on the school schedule conflicts?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can sort the drop-off times and watch for school conflicts. Just send me the details and I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Kira, I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam — can you confirm you’re actually able to help with the repair drive and let me know what you can cover?
